rules.greekMerge: Greek entries printing the same headword are one topic, matched on the exact string; a Greek topic never merges with an English headword, a construction or another Greek headword
rules.greekSlug: the transliteration of the headword without its parenthetical; when that slug is held, by an existing topic or by a Greek headword that transliterates the same way and covers more sections, the topic's first section number qualifies it

greekExclusions.alphabet-letter: the headword is one Greek letter carrying no breathing, so the entry is about the letter: its pronunciation, its quantity, what it becomes before another consonant
greekExclusions.no-section-refs: the entry cites no section, being a bare cross-reference
